annotations.text: Numbers shown are samples. Rules as drafted: A&R referral = 1 pt per round the referral lands within 1.5 of the average, first 30 days, cap 240. Artist referral = 5 x the average, rounded.
Two links per A&R: join = anr.makinitmag.com/?ref=CODE, submit = makinitmag.com/review?ref=<user uid>. The card and story carry both QRs; the Join and Submit graphics carry one each.
The face is the profile photo. The initials block is the fallback when there is none; the page asks them to add one.
